title: VoxClip project file (.voxclip), schemaVersion 1, 2, 3 or 4
description: One portable UTF-8 JSON document per project, identical on macOS and Windows. It references the source media (never embeds it) and stores the transcript, the edits (cut set, corrections, clip range layer), caption choices, export choices, share captions and cached AI clip results. Caches (levels, thumbnails, proxies) live in the app support directory, never here. Secrets never appear in this file. Semantics that JSON Schema cannot express are normative in doc/spec/editing.md section 10. The apps do not run a JSON Schema engine at runtime; they decode strictly into typed models (doc/architecture.md section 2.1), and tests validate every file the apps write against this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Readers must refuse to edit a file with a higher schemaVersion than they support (they may offer read-only preview). Any change to this schema that an older reader would misread increments it.

savedBy.description: The app that last wrote the file.

transcript.description: null until the first transcription finishes. Replacing the transcript (re-transcription) clears edits and AI results.

extensions.description: Optional. Data owned by forks or experiments, keyed by reverse-DNS name. VoxClip preserves entries it does not understand when it saves.

contextDemo.description: Optional schema-v4 source-bound capture plan. Omit when absent; never auto-load an independent sidecar.

motionCues.description: Schema-v4 source-take motion cues. Omit when empty; runtime validates clip identity, media bounds, uniqueness and at most 64 cues per clip.

music.description: Schema-v4 background tracks under clips; omit when empty. Versions 1-3 never carry it.

clipEffects.description: Schema-v4 effects (Ask Claude toolbox, doc/spec/ai.md section 18); omit when empty. Versions 1-3 never carry it.

clipControls.description: Schema-v4 per-clip speed, frame, look, volume, fades, mute, flip and rotation; omit when empty. Versions 1-3 never carry it.

captionTranslations.description: Schema-v4 translated captions over runs of words; omit when empty. Versions 1-3 never carry it.

tiltDbPerOctave.description: The tone match (voice-lab.md section 8.7 item 2b): the generated take tilted towards the spectral slope of the original speech beside it, in dB per octave (0.1 steps, within plus or minus 2), applied from the asset's first frame before gainDb. Omitted when the take is left as it is. Windows renders without it for now.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, whole seconds or fractions, always with Z.

pauseId.description: pause-after-<wordId of the item before the gap>.

position.description: Caption block position as fractions of the output width and height; same meaning as CaptionStyle position (captions spec).

mediaReference.description: Where the source media lives and how to recognise it. Resolution order and relinking: spec section 10.3.

absolutePath.description: Native absolute path on the machine that last saved the file (POSIX on macOS, drive or UNC path on Windows).

relativePath.description: Path relative to the directory containing the .voxclip file, with "/" separators (never "\"), or null when no relative path exists (different volume or drive).

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the planning timeline: the audio track's presentation-timeline duration when there is audio, otherwise the video track's. EditPlan uses this value.

contentKey.description: Source media hash: lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 "voxclip-source-v1\n" + decimal(sizeBytes) + "\n" + the first 1,048,576 bytes + the last 1,048,576 bytes (a file smaller than 2 MiB is hashed once, whole, with no tail). Same value as the architecture's cache key and the transcription cache's mediaHash. Spec section 10.3.

frameRate.description: Nominal frames per second of the source.

rotationDegrees.description: Display rotation from the container; width and height are before rotation.

audio.description: null for a source without audio; the plan then uses 48000 as its sample rate.

sampleRate.description: Native rate of the source audio track. EditPlan uses it.

transcript.description: The Transcript of doc/spec/transcription.md section 3.1, serialized with camelCase keys and null for absent optional values.

language.description: Hyphenated BCP 47 tag of the language actually used: the primary subtag for whispercpp and ElevenLabs ("et", "en"), the full locale tag for apple-speech ("en-GB", from Locale.identifier(.bcp47), never the underscore form).

durationSeconds.description: Source audio duration on the presentation timeline.

id.description: Engine id; the same vocabulary as shared/catalog/transcription-models.json engines[].id, the transcription cache file names and the CLI (whose aliases whisper and apple map to whispercpp and apple-speech).

modelId.description: Catalogue model id (models[].id in shared/catalog/transcription-models.json) for whispercpp, "scribe_v2" for ElevenLabs, null for Apple. Swift must map its property to this key with explicit CodingKeys.

modelSha256.description: whispercpp: the catalogue sha256 of the model file; null for the other engines.

locale.description: apple-speech only: the hyphenated BCP 47 locale actually used.

verbatim.description: The value used to decide the unlabeled-speech search (false runs it).

refined.description: Decoded audio was available, so tightening, refinement and the gap search ran. Sets the default pauseThresholdSeconds (0.8 or 1.0).

pipelineVersion.description: Core constant PIPELINE_VERSION of the import post-process that produced the words (1 in 0.1.0). Informational: stored words are never recomputed on open.

rawKey.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the raw cache entry's key (transcription spec section 14.2).

clipRange.description: A clip in the range layer: an inclusive word range. Never stored as cut flags.

endWordId.description: At or after startWordId in transcript order.

aiResultId.description: ai.results[].id this clip was created from; null for manual clips.

aiClipIndex.description: Index into that result's clips; null for manual clips.

selected.description: The checkbox in the Clips list; "Export N clips" exports the selected clips. New clips (manual and AI) start selected.

edits.description: The whole edit state. Source timings never change; everything here refers to transcript items by id.

pauseThresholdSeconds.description: Gaps at least this long are pauses. Set at import to 0.8 (transcript.refined) or 1.0 (not refined); a later change re-derives pauses and drops cutPauseIds that no longer exist.

pauseKeepSeconds.description: Breath kept next to each kept word when a pause is cut. Default 0.15.

cutWordIds.description: Cut transcript items, in transcript order.

corrections.description: Corrected caption text per word id. Values are JS-trimmed, non-empty and differ from the transcribed text. Timings never move.

activeClipId.description: The selected clip whose range layer is applied to preview and export; null for the full take.

styleId.description: A CaptionStyle id from shared/caption-styles; "off" burns no captions (cuts still apply).

overrides.description: Partial CaptionStyle applied as a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) over the style. Validated by the captions engine against the CaptionStyle schema; unknown keys are an error there.

position.description: User-dragged position for every aspect; null uses the style's default.

positionByAspect.description: Per-aspect position that wins over position.

clipStyle.description: How clips should be made (doc/design.md section 6.6): the chosen preset and its fields. Absent until the user chooses on the clip style card. 'auto' in captions or music leaves that choice to the AI per clip; a caption style id here is the user's fixed choice and Claude never overrides it. The creator's own choice for one clip (captionPicks by "user") wins for that clip.

captions.description: "auto", "off" or a CaptionStyle id from shared/caption-styles.

captionPicks.description: Each clip's caption look by clip id: Claude's pick (Pick styles, Make it postable), used while captions are auto or when it keeps the fixed style, or the creator's own choice for that clip (by "user"), always used. A clip without a pick renders with the project's captions. Picks for clips that no longer exist are ignored and dropped the next time picks are recorded.

overrides.description: The caption overrides this clip renders with, as captions.overrides (a JSON merge patch over the style). Omitted: the project's overrides while the style is the project's, else none.

by.description: The creator chose this clip's style. Omitted for Claude's picks.

tone.description: The tone Claude writes in (design.md sections 6.3.1 and 6.6): a tone id from shared/data/rewrite-tones.json, "as-said" for no tone change, or a saved tone's "my-..." id from settings rewrite.myTones. Omitted means Auto (Claude picks per clip) and is never written as "auto". An id the reader does not know plans as Auto.

export.description: The project's export choices, the same values the Export sheet shows. Output size, bitrate and frame rate are never stored; they are derived at export time from the source and doc/architecture.md section 4.1. Captions are burned unless captions.styleId is "off" (the Export sheet's Captions picker reads and writes captions.styleId). Framing is the centre crop in schemaVersion 1; face-tracked reframe (M2) increments schemaVersion.

aspect.description: New projects take the settings value export.defaultAspect (default "source").

quality.description: high multiplies the section 4.1 bitrate by 1.5.

srt.description: Also write the .srt sidecar next to each exported video.

folder.description: Native absolute path of the last export folder for this project; null uses the settings value export.folder, else the platform default (architecture section 2.5).

captions.description: The caption text the user edited for an export target: "full" for the full edit, otherwise a clip id from edits.clips. Entries for removed clips are pruned on load (editing spec section 10.4).

aiClip.description: One suggestion after finalizeClips validation, with word indices resolved to ids.

aiResult.description: A cached clip-finding run. Results stay valid across cuts; inputSha256 tells the UI whether corrections changed the transcript the model saw. Each run also creates ClipRange entries (origin ai) in edits.clips; see doc/spec/ai.md section 11.8.

provider.description: Connector id from shared/catalog/llm-providers.json (for example anthropic, openai, xai, gemini, ollama, lmstudio, apple-foundation, claude-code, codex).

instructions.description: The user's extra instructions; required for custom.

inputSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact transcript block sent to the model (UTF-8).

results.description: Oldest first. On save, results beyond the newest 10 that no ClipRange references are dropped.

tiltDbPerOctave.description: The tone match (voice-lab.md section 8.7 item 2b): the generated take tilted towards the spectral slope of the original speech beside it, in dB per octave (0.1 steps, within plus or minus 2), applied from the asset's first frame before gainDb. Omitted when the take is left as it is. Windows renders without it for now.

The tone match (voice-lab.md section 8.7 item 2b): the generated take tilted towards the spectral slope of the original speech beside it, in dB per octave (0.1 steps, within plus or minus 2), applied from the asset's first frame before gainDb. Omitted when the take is left as it is. Windows renders without it for now.

motionCue.description: Canonical wire only: duration is 0.1...120 seconds with 1e-9 arithmetic tolerance; progress is strictly ascending with first 0 and last 1. Runtime rejects noncanonical arrays before model normalization. Overlap is permitted for defensive evaluation; authored UI rejects it.

file.description: <projectId>/music-<slug>.<ext> under the data folder's Music root; the folder is the project id.

music.description: One background track; doc/spec/music.md section 2. Every key is written, null where a source has no value. Runtime also checks that the file folder is the project id, the clip exists and the offset is inside the track.

clipId.description: The clip this track plays under; null plays under the full-video export. At most one track per value.

license.description: Library tracks are cc0, by or pdm only (never nc, nd or sa); generated tracks are generated; own files are own.

gainDb.description: The bed level relative to the clip's measured speech loudness; -20 by default.

clipEffectRect.description: A normalized rect of the recorded frame as it plays (rotation applied), top-left origin. Runtime also checks that x + width and y + height stay inside 1.

clipEffectTrackSample.description: One tracked rect at source time t; samples are every 0.25 s, smoothed, in increasing t.

clipEffectBundledSound.description: A sound synthesized for VoxClip and bundled under shared/sfx (CC0).

clipEffectLibrarySound.description: A free library clip (Openverse category sound_effect), cc0, by or pdm only, never nc, nd or sa.

file.description: <projectId>/sfx-<slug>.<ext> under the data folder's SFX root; the folder is the project id.

clipEffect.description: One effect on a stretch of the recording; doc/spec/ai.md section 18.2. Every entry writes id, clipId, kind, start and end, plus exactly the keys its kind uses. Runtime also checks the clip and words exist, a freeze is at most 5 s, a sound spans its own length, a sticker is at most 16 scalars and a progress bar sits at the top or bottom.

clipId.description: The clip the effect belongs to; null for the full video. Censor kinds (bleep, mute, blur, pixelate) render wherever their range plays; the others only in their clip.

end.description: Source seconds, after start, at most 600 s later.

wordIds.description: The bleeped or muted words; captions show each of their letters and digits as a full block.

track.description: Empty while untracked, so rect holds.

clipControls.description: One clip's playback controls; doc/design.md section 6.9. Every key is written. Runtime also checks that the clip exists, that a clip has one entry and that no entry is stored at its defaults.

clipId.description: The clip these controls apply to; at most one entry per clip.

speed.description: Playback rate; 1 plays as recorded. The voice keeps its pitch; captions, cuts and motion follow.

shape.description: The clip's own frame; null keeps the project export frame (export.aspect).

look.description: The colour look, the same ids the clip planner writes.

gainDb.description: Source audio level in dB; 0 leaves it unchanged.

muteSource.description: Silences the clip's own audio; a music bed still plays.

captionTranslation.description: The captions of a run of words in another language; doc/spec/ai.md section 18.2. Every key is written. Runtime also checks that the words exist in order, that the clip exists, that the text is trimmed and at most 1000 scalars, and that two translations in one scope never cover the same word.

clipId.description: The clip it was made in, which alone shows it; null shows it in every render of those words.

startWordId.description: The first transcript word it covers.

endWordId.description: The last transcript word it covers.

text.description: The translation, trimmed. Its words are spread over the shown words of the range.
